title: Visibly Pushdown Languages in Groups
summary: In this paper we explore the connections between the class of Visibly Pushdown Languages ($\mathbf{VPL}$) and the natural sets of words one can associate to a finitely generated group. We show that the word problem of a finitely generated group is $\mathbf{VPL}$ exactly when the group is finite. We also show that free reduction does not preserve $\mathbf{VPL}$, and that finding solutions to equations in a free group with $\mathbf{VPL}$ constraints (as reduced words) is undecidable.
